# Public media acceptance fixture

The CI media acceptance test downloads one public Wikimedia Commons video:

- **File:** Gigaset Smartphone Production III - Screwing the back of the Smart Phones.webm
- **Source:** Wikimedia Commons
- **Purpose:** automated NEXVARY-DA quality-pipeline acceptance testing only.
- **Attribution:** Sound: Kathinka Engels; Photo/Video: Inke Pickhardt.
- **License:** Creative Commons Attribution (see the Wikimedia Commons file page for the authoritative license/version metadata).
- The asset is downloaded during CI and is **not redistributed inside NEXVARY-DA packages**.
